title: pgAssistant - Executive Plan - Tasks & Phases
description: Operational view of ordered phases and deployable work packages.

list.name: team
list.label: Team
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT team AS __value, team AS __text FROM pga_executive_plan_task_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND team IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: environment
list.label: Environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(environment,'unknown') AS __value, coalesce(environment,'unknown') AS __text FROM pga_collection_run ORDER BY 1

list.name: target_id
list.label: Target
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT target_id AS __value, coalesce(target_name,target_id) AS __text FROM pga_collection_run WHERE coalesce(environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 2

list.name: phase
list.label: Phase
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT phase_number AS __value, phase_number::text || ' - ' || name AS __text FROM pga_executive_plan_phase_snapshot ORDER BY 1

list.name: priority
list.label: Priority
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT priority AS __value, priority AS __text FROM pga_executive_plan_task_snapshot WHERE priority IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: workstream
list.label: Workstream
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT workstream AS __value, workstream AS __text FROM pga_executive_plan_task_snapshot WHERE workstream IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.target_id) p.run_id FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot p JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id=p.run_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.collected_at) AND p.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY p.target_id,p.collected_at DESC) SELECT count(*) FROM pga_executive_plan_task_snapshot t JOIN latest l USING(run_id) WHERE t.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND t.phase_number IN (${phase:csv}) AND t.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND t.workstream IN (${workstream:sqlstring});

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC) SELECT coalesce(sum(t.sql_count),0) FROM pga_executive_plan_task_snapshot t JOIN latest l USING(run_id) WHERE t.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND t.phase_number IN (${phase:csv}) AND t.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND t.workstream IN (${workstream:sqlstring});

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC) SELECT count(*) FROM pga_executive_plan_task_snapshot t JOIN latest l USING(run_id) WHERE t.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND t.phase_number IN (${phase:csv}) AND t.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND t.workstream IN (${workstream:sqlstring}) AND t.requires_maintenance_window;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC) SELECT round(avg(t.score),1) FROM pga_executive_plan_task_snapshot t JOIN latest l USING(run_id) WHERE t.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND t.phase_number IN (${phase:csv}) AND t.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND t.workstream IN (${workstream:sqlstring});

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC) SELECT t.phase_number::text || ' - ' || p.name AS phase, count(*) AS tasks FROM pga_executive_plan_task_snapshot t JOIN latest l USING(run_id) JOIN pga_executive_plan_phase_snapshot p ON p.run_id=t.run_id AND p.phase_number=t.phase_number WHERE t.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND t.phase_number IN (${phase:csv}) AND t.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND t.workstream IN (${workstream:sqlstring}) GROUP BY t.phase_number,p.name ORDER BY t.phase_number;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC) SELECT coalesce(t.workstream,'UNKNOWN') AS workstream, count(*) AS tasks FROM pga_executive_plan_task_snapshot t JOIN latest l USING(run_id) WHERE t.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND t.phase_number IN (${phase:csv}) AND t.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND t.workstream IN (${workstream:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.target_id) p.run_id,p.target_id,p.collected_at FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot p JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id=p.run_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.collected_at) AND p.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY p.target_id,p.collected_at DESC) SELECT l.target_id,t.phase_number,p.name AS phase,t.task_order,t.title,t.team,t.priority,round(t.score,1) AS score,t.workstream,t.scope_name,t.recommendation_count,t.sql_count,t.requires_maintenance_window,t.requires_restart,l.collected_at AS snapshot_at FROM latest l JOIN pga_executive_plan_task_snapshot t USING(run_id) JOIN pga_executive_plan_phase_snapshot p ON p.run_id=t.run_id AND p.phase_number=t.phase_number WHERE t.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND t.phase_number IN (${phase:csv}) AND t.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND t.workstream IN (${workstream:sqlstring}) ORDER BY l.target_id,p.phase_order,t.task_order LIMIT 500;
